title: Claude Code + Obsidian: My family’s AI brain | Scott Farrar
summary: Building a personal AI brain using Claude Code and Obsidian workflows

So he built a household brain in Claude Code: a folder of Markdown files, viewed in Obsidian, that knows his appliances, warranties, insurance documents, and everything on his family’s to-do list.
We also talk about AI and math learning, and why he wants AI to keep kids doing the thinking.

sentences: Scott Farrar is a math educator and parent who got tired of AI chats that drift and forget.
So he built a household brain in Claude Code: a folder of Markdown files, viewed in Obsidian, that knows his appliances, warranties, insurance documents, and everything on his family’s to-do list.
In this episode, Scott shows how he uses it to shop for car insurance, plan repairs, share the system with his wife, and put priority tasks and recent wins on a wall display.
We also talk about AI and math learning, and why he wants AI to keep kids doing the thinking.
